body: Pandora is given a container she is told not to open.
Curiosity wins, and she lifts the lid.
Troubles escape into the world before she can stop them.
She shuts it, but what escaped cannot simply be put back.
That contrast gives the story its lasting power.
Pandora's box became a symbol for choices that unleash consequences beyond control.
One action can create problems far larger than the action itself.
That is why people still warn against opening Pandora's box.
They mean a decision could set off trouble that spreads.
The lesson is not merely that curiosity is dangerous.
It is that some choices cannot be neatly reversed.
optional_closing: Sometimes the smallest opening changes what follows.
